3400.name: A Shady Path

north.description: To the north lies Archway to the White Gold Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies A Colorful Park.

3400.description:
Tall beeches and dark yews close overhead along this shady path, and the
gravel is soft with last autumn's leaves. Dapples of light fall through
the branches, and from somewhere ahead comes a faint white-gold glow
that looks strangely out of place among the trees. The path climbs north
toward a great archway of pale stone. Behind you it winds south back to
a colorful park, and a hum like a struck glass sings faintly in the air.

3401.name: Archway to the White Gold Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies Entering the White Gold Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies A Shady Path.

3401.description:
The archway is a tall vault of white marble veined with gold, its
keystone carved into an open eye ringed by flames. Wards crackle faintly
in the stone, and the hair on your arms lifts as you pass beneath.
Daylight from the shady path lies behind you to the south, while to the
north the vault opens into the cathedral proper. Names of wizards long
dead are chiselled in neat rows along the inner faces of the arch.

extra_descs.names inscription arch wizards:
The names run in tight, proud script, each followed by a title:
Archmagus, Warden, Master of the Seven Wards. The newest are still
faintly warm to the touch.

3402.name: Entering the White Gold Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies The White Gold Cathedral.

south.description: To the south lies Archway to the White Gold Cathedral.

3402.description:
This broad vestibule is floored in polished white stone, inlaid with a
sunburst of gold wire that gleams under unseen light. Tall niches along
the walls hold glass lamps that glow with a steady, shadowless radiance,
though no flame burns in them. The air smells of hot metal and of
lightning after rain. The vestibule opens north into the cathedral's
great nave, and the archway lies south.

3403.name: The White Gold Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies Between the Pews.

east.description: To the east lies Behind the Pews.

south.description: To the south lies Entering the White Gold Cathedral.

west.description: To the west lies Behind the Pews.

3403.description:
You stand at the crossing of the cathedral, beneath a lofty dome whose
ribs are plated in white gold and flash with every shift of the light.
Rows of pews stretch north toward a far altar, while narrow aisles run
east and west behind them. Threads of blue fire crawl along the
vaulting, held in check by the wards. The floor is a mosaic of
constellations in pale marble, and the entrance vestibule lies south.

3404.name: Behind the Pews

east.description: To the east lies The White Gold Cathedral.

west.description: To the west lies At the Corner of the Cathedral.

3404.description:
This low passage behind the pews smells of beeswax and old paper. Hooks
along the wall hold choir robes of white and gold, stiff with starch. In
a small alcove a bowl of water holds a flame that floats upon it without
sinking. The passage runs east toward the crossing and west to the
cathedral's corner.

3405.name: Behind the Pews

east.description: To the east lies At the Corner of the Cathedral.

west.description: To the west lies The White Gold Cathedral.

3405.description:
A narrow aisle runs behind the last rank of pews, its walls panelled in
pale wood and hung with brass plaques naming the cathedral's donors. A
rack of staves leans in one niche, each tipped with a dull crystal that
brightens as you approach. The passage runs west to the crossing and
east to the cathedral's corner. It smells of candle wax and ozone.

3406.name: Between the Pews

north.description: To the north lies Between the Pews.

south.description: To the south lies The White Gold Cathedral.

3406.description:
Long pews of bleached ash stand in ranks on either hand, their ends
carved with sigils of fire, water, air and earth. The kneelers are
worked in gold thread, worn pale by many proud knees. A faint static
prickles over the wood whenever you brush it. The aisle runs north
toward the altar and south back to the crossing.

3407.name: Between the Pews

north.description: To the north lies Approaching the White Gold Altar.

south.description: To the south lies Between the Pews.

3407.description:
Here the pews are benches of dark, iron-bound oak with heavy books
chained to their backs, and the pages turn slowly of their own accord,
whispering. A chandelier of beaten gold hangs overhead without chain or
hook, revolving at the pace of a sleepwalker. The glare of the altar
grows stronger along the aisle, which goes on north, while the way south
leads back between the pews.

3408.name: Approaching the White Gold Altar

north.description: To the north lies The White Gold Altar.

south.description: To the south lies Between the Pews.

3408.description:
The pews end at a low step of white granite, and the light pouring from
the altar is almost too bright to face. Gold dust drifts in the air like
pollen and settles on your sleeves. Each floor tile is etched with a
warding glyph that flares as you tread on it and fades behind you. The
altar stands just north, and the rows of pews lie south.

3409.name: The White Gold Altar

east.description: To the east lies Approaching the White Gold Altar.

south.description: To the south lies Approaching the White Gold Altar.

west.description: To the west lies Approaching the White Gold Altar.

down.description: To the down lies The Warded Labyrinth.

3409.description:
The White Gold Altar is a great block of white marble sheathed in beaten
gold, haloed in light so pure that nothing here casts a shadow. Chains
of runes crawl over its face and spit sparks into the air with a sound
like frying fat. Curved walkways sweep east and west around it, and the
aisle of pews runs south. A black iron grate in the floor, rimmed with
glowing wards, opens a stair down into the labyrinth beneath.

extra_descs.altar runes marble:
The runes on the altar shift and rearrange as you watch, forming lines
in a tongue you almost understand. Whatever they say, they seem to be
waiting for you to flinch.

3410.name: At the Corner of the Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Behind the Pews.

3410.description:
At the corner of the cathedral two walls of pale stone meet beneath a
buttress carved as a crouching gargoyle of gilded bronze. The wards on
the stone hiss softly like water on a hot plate, and a narrow window
gives a glimpse of the grounds. The hall turns north from here, and a
low passage leads west behind the pews.

3411.name: At the Corner of the Cathedral

north.description: To the north lies The Western Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Behind the Pews.

3411.description:
The corner of the cathedral here forms a small round turret room, ringed
with slit windows that look out over a sloping lawn and dark trees. A
spiral of gold is set into the floor, and a faint warmth rises from it.
The way leads north along a hallway, and a low passage opens east behind
the pews. A stool and an abandoned practice wand lie against the wall,
long forgotten.

3412.name: The Eastern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies At the Corner of the Cathedral.

3412.description:
The hallway begins to bend here, and the light turns warm and sunset-
coloured through tall panes of amber glass. Faded tapestries show
wizards hurling lightning at dragons, and their hems are singed black.
Footsteps echo from the vaulted ceiling. To the south the corner of the
cathedral waits, and the hall runs back north toward the transept.

3413.name: The Eastern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Hallway.

3413.description:
Sconces of gold shaped like clasped hands line this stretch of hallway,
each holding a flame that burns without fuel and gives off no heat. The
floor is scored with faint scorch marks, some in neat circles where
spells have been practised. A bench of white stone sits against the
wall, scratched with the initials of bored apprentices. The hall
continues north and south.

3414.name: The Warded Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Wasteroom.

up.description: To the up lies The White Gold Altar.

3414.description:
You are at a crossing in the warded labyrinth beneath the altar, a hall
of black stone where lines of gold light form a lattice over every wall.
Each line hums, and it would be unwise to touch the wrong one. Corridors
lead north toward the enchanters, east toward the alchemists, south
toward the sleeping quarters and west to a wasteroom. The air is hot and
dry, like a forge at rest.

3415.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Warded Labyrinth.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3415.description:
A broad stone passage leads toward the sleeping quarters, with a row of
identical narrow doors set in the wall and numbered in gold paint.
Footsteps are hushed by a runner of deep grey felt. The lamps are turned
low, and a smell of soap and spent candles lingers. The passage leads
north to the labyrinth, south along the cells, and west to a further
corridor.

3416.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Warded Labyrinth.

3416.description:
The alchemist's corridor begins here, running east from the labyrinth
crossing, and the air grows hot and acrid at once. The walls are tiled
in glazed white ceramic, stained in places with rainbow splashes of old
spills. A line of copper pipes runs overhead, tapping and gurgling. The
corridor continues east, and the labyrinth lies west.

3417.name: The Eastern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Transept.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Hallway.

3417.description:
A long hallway lined with narrow arched windows, each throwing a bar of
white light across the flagstones. Between them hang portraits of stern
robed figures whose painted eyes seem to follow you, and one gilt frame
crackles when you pass. The hallway runs north to the transept and south
along the wing. Not a speck of dust lies anywhere, burnt away by the
wards.

3418.name: The Eastern Transept

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Approaching the White Gold Altar.

3418.description:
This transept is a high-ceilinged arm of the cathedral, its walls hung
with banners of white silk stitched in gold with the arms of old wizard
houses. A stone lectern stands in one corner with a great book chained
to it, its edges glowing like a coal. The walkway returns west toward
the altar, while a hallway leads south. Sparks jump between the banner
poles with soft snaps.

3419.name: Approaching the White Gold Altar

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Transept.

west.description: To the west lies The White Gold Altar.

3419.description:
A wide walkway curves around the altar's flank, its floor a spiral of
gold inlay on white stone. Tall windows of colourless glass, set with
prisms, scatter small rainbows across the wall. The glare of the altar
lies back to the west, and the walkway goes on east toward a transept.
The air tingles and tastes faintly of copper.

3420.name: The Western Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Western Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies At the Corner of the Cathedral.

3420.description:
The hall dips by two shallow steps, and the walls close in, panelled in
dark wood inlaid with little gold stars. A runner of white wool, singed
in a hundred tiny places, muffles your steps. A single lamp burns with a
cold blue flame beside an unmarked door that will not open. The hall
runs north toward the transept, and the cathedral's corner lies south.

3421.name: The Western Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Western Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Hallway.

3421.description:
Glass cases of curiosities line this hallway: a shard of living flame in
a bottle, a feather that will not fall, a pebble that hums to itself.
Each case bears a small plaque in a crabbed, haughty hand. The cases
rattle gently whenever a pulse of the wards travels through the floor.
Passages lead north and south from here.

3422.name: The Western Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Western Transept.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Hallway.

3422.description:
Frosted windows fill one wall of this hallway, and the light that
filters through is pale and cold as moonlight. The floor is flagged in
white stone with a seam of gold running down its centre like a vein of
ore. A coat-stand of wrought silver holds a few scorched cloaks. The
wing carries on south, and the transept lies north.

3423.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Warded Labyrinth.

3423.description:
The enchanter's corridor begins here in a passage of smooth dark stone,
hung with strings of tiny glass beads that chime together as the wards
pulse. Panels of gold leaf along the walls glow faintly from within. The
smell is of hot wax, ink and something sweet and burnt. The corridor
runs north, and the labyrinth crossing lies south.

3424.name: The Western Transept

east.description: To the east lies Approaching the White Gold Altar.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Hallway.

3424.description:
This transept rises into shadowy vaults, and its windows of stained
glass show the four elements as crowned figures in red, blue, gold and
green. A great brass orrery stands in the middle of the floor, its rings
and little moons turning by themselves with a soft tick. The walkway
leads east back toward the altar, and a hallway runs south. Coloured
light falls across the tiles in slow, shifting patches.

extra_descs.orrery brass rings:
The orrery's brass rings carry a sun of gold and nine little moons, and
they do not agree with any sky you know. The innermost moon stops and
starts, as if listening.

3425.name: The Wasteroom

east.description: To the east lies The Warded Labyrinth.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3425.description:
The wasteroom is a cramped, tiled chamber with a stone trough running
along one wall and a vent in the ceiling that sucks in the air with a
thin whistle. Buckets of spent reagents and scorched robes are heaped in
the corner, awaiting the burning-pit. Everything here smells of lye and
rot. The labyrinth crossing is east of here, and a bunk-hall lies south.

3426.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

south.description: To the south lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3426.description:
The corridor turns here, and the ceiling lowers to brush the tops of the
lamps. Shelves cut into the wall hold hundreds of small rings and
amulets, set out on velvet and glowing faintly where they await their
charms. The passage leads west along the corridor, and south back toward
the labyrinth. Little blue sparks drift between the shelves like
fireflies.

3427.name: Approaching the White Gold Altar

east.description: To the east lies The White Gold Altar.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Transept.

3427.description:
The walkway curves around the altar's other flank, and here the pillars
are of white marble, each one wrapped by a spiralling serpent of gold.
The floor is worn bright by the passage of many robes. Heat and light
roll off the altar close by to the east, while the walkway sweeps on
west toward a transept. A single stray spark skitters along the floor
and vanishes.

3428.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3428.description:
Etched on the walls here are long columns of tiny runes, each glowing a
different shade as though it were counting something. The floor is
scattered with filings of gold and silver that swirl in small whirlwinds
around your feet. The passage turns north toward the corridor's heart,
and the way east leads back round the bend. The air thrums with slow,
patient power.

3429.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Master Enchanter's Quarters .

3429.description:
The corridor opens into a small junction before a heavy door of gilded
oak that stands ajar to the west, the way into the Master Enchanter's
quarters. A brass plate on the door gives the master's name and a long
list of grudges. The floor here is paved in alternate squares of black
and white stone, and some squares glow when stepped upon. The corridor
leads east, and back south toward the bend.

3430.name: The Master Enchanter's Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3430.description:
The Master Enchanter's quarters are crowded with the clutter of a long
and conceited life: a four-poster bed hung with gold-threaded curtains,
a desk piled with unfinished commissions, a mirror whose reflections lag
behind you by a heartbeat. Rugs of white fur overlap on the floor, and a
tall window of frosted glass lets in a diffuse, flawless light. A fire
burns in a grate without ever consuming its logs. The only door leads
east to the corridor.

extra_descs.mirror:
The mirror shows you a heartbeat late, and its reflection looks far more
confident than you feel. The frame is cast in gold, engraved with the
words Know Your Betters.

3431.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3431.description:
Glass-fronted cabinets line this stretch of the corridor, each full of
half-finished charms: gloves that flex by themselves, boots stitched
with silver thread, belts that coil like sleeping snakes. A thin film of
gold dust coats everything, and nobody seems to mind. The passage runs
east and west, and every footstep sets the cabinet doors chattering.

3432.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3432.description:
Round windows of coloured glass pierce the wall here, though they look
onto nothing but solid stone, and they cast beams of ruby and sapphire
across the floor. A workbench of pale wood stands against the wall,
stained and scorched by years of careless incantation. The corridor goes
on east and back west. The air is thick with the scent of cloves and
burnt hair.

3433.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3433.description:
The corridor bends sharply here, and the walls are hung with rolls of
parchment pinned in rows, each scrawled with a different binding
formula. Several have charred edges, as though their authors lost an
argument with them. Oil lamps burn with a green flame along the way. The
passage leads north to a dead-end alcove, and west back along the
corridor.

3434.name: The Enchanter's Corridor

south.description: To the south lies The Enchanter's Corridor.

3434.description:
This is a dead-end alcove, and its ceiling is hung with dozens of tiny
bells of gold that ring softly with no breeze to stir them. A cushioned
stool stands before a cracked scrying bowl, and a ring of scorch marks
on the floor shows where some experiment went wrong. Only the corridor
south offers a way back. A heavy stillness presses on the ears.

3435.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3435.description:
A long dormitory passage, its walls lined with narrow bunks built into
alcoves and curtained with white linen. Trunks sit at the foot of each,
strapped and padlocked, some bearing the scorch marks of failed wards. A
single glass lamp swings from a hook, throwing wide, slow shadows. The
passage runs north and south.

3436.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3436.description:
The passage bends here, and the bunks give way to a small common space,
with a table of scarred oak and a few stools, still littered with a
half-played game of rune-stones. A cold hearth fills one wall, its
mantel crowded with candle stubs. The way leads north back along the
cells and west toward a further hall.

3437.name: The Sleeping Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3437.description:
Here the dormitory narrows to a low, plain hall, its bunks stacked two
high and hung with threadbare quilts. Chalk drawings of spell circles
cover the lower walls, some smudged out in a hurry, and the whole hall
smells of damp wool. A draught of cool air flows along it. You may go
east or west along the hall.

3438.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3438.description:
The dormitory turns a corner here, and the air grows close and warm from
the heat of a stove that never goes out. A row of cots lines each wall
under shelves of battered spell-books bristling with paper markers.
Someone has scratched a rude caricature of the Archmagus into the
plaster, and a sharp-eyed monitor has tried to scrub it out. The hall
leads north and east.

3439.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3439.description:
A narrow part of the dormitory, where the walls are hung with long rows
of pegs bearing grey travelling cloaks and pointed hats. A bench runs
beneath them, scattered with boots, and the stone floor is polished by
thousands of nervous footsteps. Lamps in wire cages give a dim,
yellowish light. You can go north or back south.

3440.name: The Sleeping Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3440.description:
This landing is a meeting of three passages, and the floor is chalked
with a great ring of duelling lines in red and gold. The walls bear
scars of scorching and long gouges cut by spell-fire. A rack of practice
wands stands by the west passage, which is lined with banners of crimson
silk. The dormitory leads south and east, while a harsher corridor runs
west.

3441.name: The Hit Wizards Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3441.description:
The hit wizards' corridor starts as a grim, bare passage of grey stone,
its walls hung with crossed wands of black ebony and the bright red
banners of the order. The floor is scored with bootmarks from endless
drills. A tang of singed air lingers. The passage runs east back toward
the sleeping quarters and west deeper into the order's wing.

3442.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Wasteroom.

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3442.description:
The sleeping quarters broaden here into a bunk-hall with a high beamed
ceiling, hung with paper charms against bad dreams. Rows of cots are
made up with military neatness under blankets of undyed wool. A distant
dripping drifts in from the north, where a foul-smelling room waits.
Ways lead east and west along the hall.

3443.name: The Master Hit Wizards Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3443.description:
The Master Hit Wizards' quarters are spare and martial: a bare cot, a
chest bound in iron, a rack of wands and a wall hung with ranks of
broken enemy staves as trophies. A single red banner hangs over the bed,
stitched with a lightning bolt. The floor shows the marks of pacing, a
worn path from door to window. The only way out is north.

3444.name: The Hit Wizards Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Master Hit Wizards Quarters.

3444.description:
A small guardroom opens off the corridor here, with a table bearing a
map of the cathedral weighted with daggers. Racks of long gloves and
wand-cases line the walls, all oiled and ready. The air is charged, and
a tinge of blue lightning crawls over the iron lamp brackets. The
corridor runs north and east, and a door south leads to the master's
quarters.

3445.name: The Hit Wizards Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3445.description:
Targets of straw-stuffed leather hang from the walls of this passage,
blackened and pierced by spell-fire. Sand has been spread thickly over
the floor to catch stray sparks, and it crunches underfoot. Spent wand-
cores lie in the corners, burnt to charcoal. The corridor runs north and
south.

3446.name: The Hit Wizards Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3446.description:
The corridor makes a right angle here, and the vaulted ceiling is lined
with sheets of beaten iron, dented and blistered by the practice of
generations. A line of crimson paint marks where the novices must stand.
The floor is pocked with small craters. The way leads east along the
wing and south back toward the guardroom.

3447.name: The Hit Wizards Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3447.description:
A plain stone passage, brightly lit by a row of white-gold crystals set
in iron cages along the ceiling. The crystals buzz like angry wasps.
Names are carved in the walls beside small dents the size of a fist, as
if a hundred graduates had struck them in passing. The passage runs on
east, and back west.

3448.name: The Hit Wizards Corridor

west.description: To the west lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

down.description: To the down lies The Crumbling Labyrinth.

3448.description:
The corridor ends in a round, bare chamber whose floor is crossed with
seared lines, the marks of a hundred failed duels. A circle of black
iron is set in the middle of it, and beneath is a rough stair spiralling
down into darkness and cold dust. A scrap of scorched red silk hangs
from the lintel. The corridor leads west, and the stair goes down.

3449.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3449.description:
The corridor turns here, and a stained drain in the middle of the floor
leaks a thin curl of yellow vapour. Shelves of stoppered jars climb the
walls, each labelled in a tiny cramped hand with warnings no sane person
would ignore. A faint hissing comes from behind the tiles. The way leads
south along the corridor, and west back toward the labyrinth.

3450.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3450.description:
Racks of glass tubing hang along this passage, bubbling with liquids of
impossible colours: violet, sulphur-yellow, an oily black that swallows
the light. A drip falls somewhere with a slow, regular plink. The air
stings the eyes and the throat. Corridors run north and south from here.

3451.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3451.description:
A long bench of grey slate runs down one wall, crowded with alembics,
mortars and spirit lamps, their burners left lit to simmer. Splashes of
acid have eaten pits into the slate, and a hand-lettered sign begs
visitors not to breathe too deeply. The corridor goes on north and
south. Somewhere a kettle shrieks and falls silent.

3452.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Apprentice's Quarters.

3452.description:
Three ways meet at this junction of the alchemist's corridor, beneath a
ceiling blackened by fumes. A round door of brass stands to the east,
marked with the sign of the Alchemist, while to the west a plainer
wooden door leads to the apprentice's quarters. The floor is crusted
with dried reagents that crunch beneath your feet. The corridor
continues north and south.

3453.name: The Alchemist's Quarters

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3453.description:
The alchemist's private quarters are crowded with books and jars, and a
narrow cot is shoved into a corner as though sleep were an afterthought.
A great copper still squats in the middle of the floor, its coils
swollen and green with verdigris. Dried herbs hang in bunches from the
beams, and the room reeks of mint and sulphur. The only way out is west,
back to the corridor.

3454.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3454.description:
Stained tiles lead on through this stretch of corridor, and a trail of
footprints in white powder marks the floor, as if somebody had walked it
dragging a split sack. Gas lamps burn low and blue, their glass cracked
and mended with wire. The air is warm and carries a metallic tang. The
corridor runs north to the junction and south to a crossing.

3455.name: The Apprentice's Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3455.description:
The apprentice's quarters are tiny, and every surface is covered with
scribbled notes and stained garments. A narrow cot sits under a dripping
pipe, its blanket singed in several places, and a bowl of something
green is left to sour on the sill. Burnt fingerprints dot the doorframe.
The only way out is east, back to the corridor.

3456.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3456.description:
The passage divides into a crossing here: it runs east into a short
blind spur and west toward the chamber of the alchemists, while the
corridor you came by runs north. Ladles and tongs hang from hooks,
blackened by heat, and a bucket of grey sand stands ready for fires. The
tiles are cracked and spotted with old burns. A low roar sounds from
somewhere deep in the walls.

3457.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemy Chamber.

3457.description:
A short and narrow corridor leads toward the alchemy chamber, its walls
patched with sheets of lead to keep the fumes in. Warning symbols are
chalked above the arch of the entrance, a skull, a flame, a bubbling
flask. The corridor runs east back toward the crossing, and the chamber
opens west. The heat that rolls through the arch is like an oven door
opening.

3458.name: The Alchemy Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemy Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemy Chamber.

3458.description:
The alchemy chamber is a great vaulted room of white-glazed brick, with
a ring of furnaces round its walls that glow orange through iron
grilles. Heavy tables hold crucibles, retorts and graduated cylinders,
and coils of glass pipe connect them in tangled loops. A bitter vapour
hangs under the ceiling. The chamber opens east to the corridor and
continues south and west.

extra_descs.furnaces grilles:
The furnaces burn white-orange behind their grilles. Each is stamped
with a maker's mark of an open flame over a gold crown.

3459.name: The Alchemy Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemy Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemy Chamber.

3459.description:
A line of vats stands along the wall here, each as tall as a man and
filled with a slowly stirring liquid that glows green and then gold.
Brass rails run round them, polished by the sleeves of many hurried
workers. The floor is wet and slick in patches. The chamber goes on
north and west.

3460.name: The Alchemy Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemy Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Alchemy Chamber.

3460.description:
A great athanor, a tall furnace shaped like a tower, dominates this
corner of the alchemy chamber and fills it with a deep red glow. Pans of
lead and mercury bubble on iron trivets, and the heat is almost solid
against the skin. The scorched floor leads east and south through the
smoke.

3461.name: The Alchemist's Corridor

west.description: To the west lies The Alchemist's Corridor.

3461.description:
This short spur ends in a blank wall of soot-black brick, plainly once a
furnace room. A cold iron stove stands open against the wall, full of
grey ash and fused glass. The air is stale and smells of scorched metal
and old smoke. The only way out is west, back to the crossing.

3462.name: The Alchemy Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Alchemy Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies The Alchemy Chamber.

3462.description:
This corner of the chamber is crowded with towering shelves of dusty
reagents: salts, sulphurs, pale powders and the dried parts of things
best left unnamed. A rolling ladder leans against the shelves, and a
scale of fine gold sits on a stand, tipped to one side by a forgotten
weight. The air is cold here after the furnace heat. Gaps in the shelves
lead north and east.

3463.name: The Crumbling Labyrinth

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies A Well Used Path.

up.description: To the up lies The Hit Wizards Corridor.

3463.description:
You are in a crumbling crossing of passages that once belonged to a
greater labyrinth. The ceiling has sagged, and fallen plaster lies in
drifts, with the old wards still sputtering through the cracks like
trapped insects. Dust hangs heavy in the air and clings to your tongue.
Corridors lead north, east, south and west from this ruined hub.

3464.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Crumbling Labyrinth.

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3464.description:
The elementalist's corridor starts here, a passage where the stones are
streaked with soot on one side and glazed with frost on the other. Warm
and cold winds seem to chase each other along its length, tugging at
your clothes. Puddles stand where the frost melts, and cinders glow
where the soot burns. The corridor runs north to the crumbling crossing
and south into the wing.

3465.name: The Sleeping Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Crumbling Labyrinth.

3465.description:
This end of the old sleeping quarters opens toward a ruined crossing.
The walls are cracked from floor to ceiling, and a spill of rubble
blocks one corner, the fallen stones glittering with flecks of gold.
Moss grows in the seams where moisture seeps in. The hall runs east into
the old quarters and west to the crumbling crossing.

3466.name: The Grand Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Crumbling Labyrinth.

3466.description:
A wide corridor of cold grey marble, grander than anything in the wing
behind you, though cracked and stained by seepage. Tall pilasters rise
along the walls, topped by gold leaf capitals half flaked away. A carpet
of faded crimson runs down the middle, rotted to threads at the edges.
The corridor leads north, and south to the crumbling crossing.

3467.name: A Well Used Path

east.description: To the east lies The Crumbling Labyrinth.

west.description: To the west lies A Well Used Path.

3467.description:
A well used path of trodden stone crosses this hall, its flags worn into
shallow troughs by countless feet. Iron lanterns hang from hooks in the
wall, giving a steady yellow light. The air is chill and carries a damp,
mossy smell. The path runs east to the crumbling crossing and west
further into the dark.

3468.name: The Grand Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Corridor.

3468.description:
Great arched niches line the walls here, each empty of the statue it
once held, only the plinths remaining with their carved names. A draught
blows the dust in curling streamers along the floor. High above, a line
of dark windows is crusted with ancient grime. The grand corridor
continues north and south.

3469.name: The Grand Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Corridor.

3469.description:
The corridor rises a step or two here, and the marble floor is inlaid
with a long band of gold set with ruby chips that leads onward. Bronze
lamps hang in their brackets, dented and green. A scorched patch the
size of a cart-wheel marks the stone. The way runs north to a junction
and south the way you came.

3470.name: The Grand Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Corridor.

3470.description:
The grand corridor continues west of the hall of four ways, and its
pillars lean slightly, tilted by some old convulsion of the earth. Faded
murals of battling elementals peel from the plaster in long curls. A
thin shaft of white-gold light falls from a crack in the vault. The way
runs east to the hall of columns and west toward a guardpost.

3471.name: The Grand Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Throne.

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Corridor.

3471.description:
The grand corridor opens into a hall of four ways, its roof upheld by
tall columns of veined white marble. Straight ahead to the north stands
a pair of towering doors, plated with beaten gold, flung wide to show
the throne beyond. Cross-corridors lead east and west, and the passage
runs back south. The light is gold, bright and unforgiving.

3472.name: The Grand Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Corridor.

3472.description:
Here the corridor is hung with long gilt-framed portraits, each of a
stern, jewelled figure in the white robes of an archmagus. The glass
over several of them is cracked, and one frame is empty, its canvas cut
away. The floor is worn into a shallow groove down the middle. The
corridor leads east and back west.

extra_descs.portraits frames:
Every portrait shows an archmagus with the same lifted chin and the same
disdainful eyes. The empty frame bears a brass plate with a name that
has been scratched out.

3473.name: The Grand Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Treasury.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Corridor.

3473.description:
The grand corridor ends in a small marble landing with branching doors.
To the north stands a vault door of black steel banded with gold,
studded with locks that seem to shift, and a plainer passage leads south
to the sleeping quarters. The air carries a faint smell of oil and iron.
The corridor leads back west.

3474.name: The Grand Throne

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Corridor.

3474.description:
The Grand Throne rises at the far end of a high vaulted room, a seat of
white marble and gold elevated on seven steps, its back carved like a
sunburst. Banners of gold-and-white hang limp from the rafters, and the
floor is a vast mosaic of an eye within a flame. Static crackles around
the throne, and the air feels weighed down with arrogance. The only way
out is south, back to the grand corridor.

extra_descs.throne sunburst steps:
The throne's marble is cold as a grave. The sunburst on its back has
been carved with such pride that you can almost hear the sculptor's
patron insisting on more rays.

3475.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3475.description:
A long hall of cots stretches here, but the beds are older and grander,
with carved headboards and canopies of faded gold brocade. Dust lies
thick on the pillows, and the sheets are spotted with mildew. A tall
mirror stands cracked in one corner. The hall leads north to the grand
corridor and south further into the old quarters.

3476.name: The Treasury

south.description: To the south lies The Grand Corridor.

3476.description:
The treasury is a small, windowless chamber of white stone, its walls
lined with iron-bound chests and shelves of ingots stamped with a
sunburst. Most of the vaults stand open and empty, their locks long ago
picked or blasted. A scatter of dull coin lies trodden into the dust. A
single lamp hangs from the ceiling, burning with a steady, miserly
flame. A door south is the sole way out.

3477.name: The Sleeping Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3477.description:
A low hall running through the oldest of the sleeping quarters, its
ceiling stained black by centuries of lamp smoke. Rusted bed frames line
the walls, and the only decoration left is a single faded sunburst
painted high above the doorway. A cold draught carries the smell of damp
stone along the hall. It leads east and west.

3478.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3478.description:
A bend in the old quarters where the bunks have been broken for
firewood, leaving only a few blackened frames. A cold hearth in the wall
is choked with ash and charred bone-white splinters. Faint scratches of
runes still glimmer on the flagstones, flickering when you pass. The
hall leads north and west.

3479.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3479.description:
A junction of the old sleeping quarters, where the beds have been shoved
aside to make room for a heap of broken furniture. A rotted tapestry of
a mountain sunset still clings to the wall, its colours leached to grey.
Faint scratch marks run across the flagstones. Passages lead north, east
and south.

3480.name: The Sleeping Quarters

south.description: To the south lies The Sleeping Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3480.description:
A square room of cots, many overturned, with broken lamps and shattered
glass crunching underfoot. Someone has scrawled a chalk warning on the
wall in a wavering hand, though time has half erased it. The air is cold
and still, and a draught whispers under the door. The passage leads
south and west.

3481.name: The Sleeping Quarters

west.description: To the west lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3481.description:
This tiny cell, hardly more than a closet, holds a single narrow bed and
a washstand with a cracked basin. A shuttered window of black glass is
set in the wall, and no light has come through it in years. The air is
stale and still. The only way out is west.

3482.name: The Sleeping Quarters

north.description: To the north lies The Sleeping Quarters.

east.description: To the east lies The Sleeping Quarters.

3482.description:
The old quarters turn east here, and a row of tall wardrobes stands open
against the wall, spilling moth-eaten robes onto the floor. A ruined
harp leans in a corner, its strings snapped and curled. The plaster is
stained in long dark streaks where water has crept in. You may go north,
or east along the hall.

3483.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3483.description:
A dead-end alcove at the end of the elementalist's corridor, with a
bench of soapstone and a small hearth set in the wall. A ring of
scorched flagstones shows where some practice went wrong, and a bucket
of sand and a bucket of water stand ready. A dusty window of green glass
casts a watery light. The only way out is east.

3484.name: A Well Used Path

east.description: To the east lies A Well Used Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Well.

3484.description:
The path ends against a wall of old, mossy stone with a low arch cut
into it, from which a cool draught blows. A stone bench stands beside
it, polished by long use. Black beetles hurry along a crack in the wall.
You may go east, or south through the arch.

3485.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3485.description:
Three passages meet in a small round hall, and its dome has been painted
with a cloudy sky that rumbles quietly with thunder. A thin film of
water runs down the wall opposite a ledge of smouldering charcoal. The
floor tiles are cracked from alternate heat and chill. The hall opens
north, and east and west along the elementalist's corridor.

3486.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3486.description:
A passage lit by fire-opals set into the ceiling, each throwing a ruddy
glow. The walls are black glass, smooth and cold, reflecting your
passage in warped red shapes. Little lizards of flame, carved in relief,
seem to scurry along the wall when the light shifts. The corridor goes
east and west.

3487.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3487.description:
The air is damp here, and the stone walls are slick with condensation,
pearling and running in thin rivulets onto the floor. Blue-green
crystals jut from the ceiling, glowing like deep sea lanterns. Your
footsteps splash faintly in the standing water. The corridor continues
east and west.

3488.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3488.description:
The passage descends gently through a stretch lined with shelves of clay
jars sealed with wax, each stamped with an element's sign. A smell of
damp earth and sulphur drifts up. The tiles are swept clean, but a layer
of grit coats the windowsills. The way runs north to the crossing and
south along the corridor.

3489.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3489.description:
A crossing where gusts blow from every direction, scattering chalk dust
and torn scraps of parchment. Brass weathervanes spin on the ceiling,
pointing nowhere in particular. The walls are scored with scorch marks
that spiral outward. Passages run east and west, and another leads
south.

3490.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3490.description:
Stone pillars here are cracked down the middle by some elemental blow,
split with veins of fused glass. Gravel and loose rubble crunch
underfoot, and the air smells of struck flint. A line of iron braziers
stands cold along the wall. The corridor runs east and back west.

3491.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3491.description:
The corridor makes a turn, and along its walls are mounted shields of
beaten copper, each embossed with a roaring face of storm, flame, stone
or wave. The copper has gone green with age, and the metal faces seem to
scowl at passers-by. A thin smell of lightning hangs in the air. The way
leads north toward the master's door and west along the corridor.

3492.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Master Elementalist's Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3492.description:
A short, well-kept passage ends in a tall door of dark oak bound with
copper and carved with swirling storms. A mat of woven reeds lies before
it, scrubbed clean. The door stands north of here, set in a frame that
glows with a restless amber light. The passage leads south to the
corridor.

3493.name: The Master Elementalist's Quarters

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3493.description:
The Master Elementalist's quarters are a round chamber with a domed
ceiling painted with four great faces, one for each element, glaring
down. A bed stands on a dais of volcanic glass, and a desk is covered in
notes and half-melted candles. A brazier burns beside a basin of still
water, and neither has ever put out the other. The door south returns to
the corridor.

3494.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3494.description:
The corridor narrows between two walls of bare, rough stone, damp and
cold to the touch, as if the room had been carved from a cavern. Tiny
crystals glimmer in the crevices. A trickle runs along a channel in the
floor and vanishes through a grate. You may go north or south.

3495.name: The Well

north.description: To the north lies A Well Used Path.

3495.description:
The Well is a small round chamber, its centre taken up by a wide stone
well-head with a rusty windlass and a rotted rope. A ring of pale moss
grows around the rim, and the water far below gives back a faint glimmer
of gold. Drips echo in the shaft, and the air is cold and smells of
minerals. The passage back leads north.

extra_descs.well windlass rope:
The well is very deep, and a coin dropped into it would take a long time
to answer. The water below shimmers with gold, as though the altar's
light had seeped down through the stone.

3496.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

3496.description:
The corridor makes a sharp turn, and the air grows chill and dry. Frost
gathers on the iron fittings, and the lamps burn small and low. Traces
of old claw marks run down the walls, filled with grime. The way leads
north back along the corridor and west to a stairhead.

3497.name: The Elementalist's Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Elementalist's Corridor.

down.description: To the down lies Entrance to the Warded Castle.

3497.description:
A small landing opens on a stairwell of black stone, spiralling steeply
down into a deep, chill darkness. The arch above it bears the faded
inscription of the Warded Castle, and the great iron gate that once
barred it hangs open on broken hinges. Cold air rises from below,
tasting of wet stone and old magic. The corridor runs east, and the
stair goes down.

3498.name: The Grand Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Guards Room.

3498.description:
The corridor turns here, its gold-edged flagstones lifted and cracked
like a dried riverbed. A pair of statues in white robes flanks the way
south, both headless, their stumps scorched. The air feels brittle and
charged, like the moment before a thunderclap. The passage leads east
along the grand corridor and south to a guard room.

3499.name: The Guards Room

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Corridor.

3499.description:
The guard room is a bare square chamber of grey stone, furnished with a
heavy table, a rack of halberds and a bench worn smooth by waiting. A
brazier of white-gold coals burns at its heart, the only light, and
shadows leap on the walls. Scratched tallies of days and duties cover a
whole panel of wall. The only door opens north.

651900.name: apprentice wizard singed
651900.long_desc: A singed apprentice wizard in a scorched white robe hurries about with a smug, hurried air.
651900.description:
A young wizard in a white robe with gold piping, the hem blackened by
failed experiments. Sparks crawl over the fingers of one hand, and the
look in the eyes is disdainful.

651901.name: elementalist mage robed
651901.long_desc: A robed elementalist stands amid swirling gusts of flame and frost, muttering over a hovering spark.
651901.description:
A tall mage in robes that shift from ember red to glacier blue as they
move. Wind and cinders circle the hands, and the eyes burn with arrogant
power.

651902.name: golem guardian gold white
651902.long_desc: A white-gold golem stands motionless in the way, runes glowing along its limbs.
651902.description:
A hulking figure of white stone plated with beaten gold, its fists as
large as anvils. Runes burn along its limbs, and a point of cold light
shines where a face should be.

651903.name: hit wizard crimson battle
651903.long_desc: A crimson hit wizard prowls the corridor with a crackling wand held ready.
651903.description:
A hard-faced battle wizard in a crimson coat laced with iron wire. Two
ebony wands ride at the hip, and a bolt of lightning dances along a
third in the off hand.

651904.name: alchemist master vial
651904.long_desc: The master alchemist hovers over a bubbling crucible, tossing powders into a green flame.
651904.description:
A stooped alchemist in a leather apron etched with acid burns and belted
with a clinking row of vials. The skin of the hands is stained gold and
silver, and the smile is cold.

651905.name: kestrane warden mage throne
651905.short_desc: Kestrane, Warden of the Grand Throne
651905.long_desc: Kestrane, Warden of the Grand Throne, stands beside the seat with a staff of white gold, as stern as the stone.
651905.description:
A towering mage in armoured white robes, a gold circlet on the brow and
a staff in both hands. Her stare is flat and imperious, and the air near
her trembles with held lightning.

651906.name: archmagus vorlath wizard gilded
651906.long_desc: Archmagus Vorlath the Gilded stands before the White Gold Altar, wreathed in light that no shadow can cross.
651906.description:
An ancient, regal wizard in robes of woven gold, the face smooth and
unlined as a mask. His eyes are white with power, and the wards of the
cathedral flare to his every breath. He regards intruders with the weary
scorn of one who has never been bested.

751900.name: staff gilded wardstaff white gold
751900.room_desc: A gilded wardstaff of white gold lies here, humming softly.
751900.description: A tall staff of pale wood sheathed in white gold, capped by a crystal that burns like a tiny sun. It hums in the hand, and sparks leap from its butt when it strikes the floor.

751901.name: mantle cloak gold archmagus
751901.room_desc: A mantle of woven gold lies here in a shining heap.
751901.description: A heavy cloak of white wool shot through with threads of gold, lined with silk the colour of dawn. Faint wards crackle along its hem.

751902.name: signet ring warden gold
751902.room_desc: A gold signet ring lies here, glinting.
751902.description: A heavy gold ring set with a flat white stone carved with a throne in a flame. It is warm against the skin and tingles slightly.

751903.name: dagger wand ebony hit wizard
751903.room_desc: An ebony wand-dagger with a crimson grip lies here.
751903.description: A slim dagger of black ebony with a blade of ground crystal, balanced for thrust and spell alike. A thin crimson cord is wound round the grip.

751904.name: shard wardstone crystal white
751904.room_desc: A glittering shard of wardstone lies here.
751904.description: A sliver of white crystal veined with gold, still faintly warm. Collectors of arcane curios would pay well for it.
